highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 4.147 previews Skia m147 with variable fonts, animated WebP encoding, and new platform assets.
highlights_body: The v4 preview line also introduces SKPathBuilder, color font palettes, explicit surface sampling, CICP color spaces, and zero-copy access to memory-backed streams. It raises the WebAssembly native-asset floor to .NET 8 and includes several migration-sensitive runtime changes.

breaking.title: WebAssembly native assets now require .NET 8
breaking.body: Native assets for the Emscripten versions used by .NET 6 and .NET 7 are removed. Move Blazor WebAssembly and Uno WebAssembly applications to .NET 8 or later before adopting this release.

breaking.title: Tizen 32-bit native assets are removed
breaking.body: The Skia m147 transition removes the EOL Tizen arm and x86 native packages. Move Tizen deployments to the new tizen-arm64 or tizen-x64 assets.

breaking.title: Parameterless SKFont uses an empty typeface
breaking.body: `new SKFont()` no longer resolves the platform default typeface when text is drawn. Construct it with `SKTypeface.Default` when text measurement or rendering should use the default font.

breaking.title: Missing font families fall back on Android
breaking.body: `SKTypeface.FromFamilyName` now returns `SKTypeface.Default` instead of null for a missing family on Android. Use `SKFontManager.Default.MatchFamily` when strict not-found detection is required.

breaking.title: SKStream.Move(long) rejects out-of-range offsets
breaking.body: The long overload is obsolete and now throws `OverflowException` instead of silently truncating values outside the 32-bit native range. Validate the offset and call `Move(int)`.

breaking.title: Vulkan YCbCr conversion type renamed
breaking.body: `GRVkImageInfo.YcbcrConversionInfo` now uses `GRVkYcbcrConversionInfo`; the old `GrVkYcbcrConversionInfo` value-equality members are absent from the new type. Update type references and equality code.

breaking.title: Assembly version advances to 4.x
breaking.body: SkiaSharp.dll now reports assembly version 4.147.0.0 instead of 3.119.0.0. Update strong-name binding redirects and any hard-coded assembly-version checks.

bullets.lead: Skia advances from m119 to m147
bullets.detail: The engine update brings improved image orientation, HDR and wide-gamut processing, filter correctness, immutable paths through SKPathBuilder, and newer codec and Vulkan structures.
SKTypeface and HarfBuzzSharp can query variation axes, select design positions and named instances, and choose or override color font palettes.
SKWebpEncoder can encode frame sequences with durations into animated WebP output, with span-based frame input and stream overloads.
SKSurface.Draw and SKCanvas.DrawSurface gain SKSamplingOptions overloads for selecting filtering and mipmapping during surface composition.
SKStream.GetData() returns ref-counted SKData when the stream can expose its contents directly.
Adds SKColorSpace.CreateCicp, SKDocument.CreateXps options, per-resource GRContext.Flush overloads, SKMaskFilter.CreateShader, and new HDR color types.
HBColor models hb_color_t channel ordering and provides conversions to and from SKColor and SKColorF.

bullets.lead: Font fallback and variable-font handling corrected
bullets.detail: Default typeface resolution no longer crashes on Android API 36, undersized variation spans are handled correctly, and ContainsGlyphs avoids infinite recursion.
SKPath avoids flushing a builder that has already been finalized when garbage collection tears the objects down in either order.
Returning to a MAUI TabBar tab or navigated page now restores the GL surface at the current view dimensions instead of leaving it blank.

bullets.lead: NanoServer starts without a font subsystem
bullets.detail: The default font manager now uses an empty implementation on NanoServer instead of crashing during static initialization.

bullets.lead: Linux Bionic assets for x64 and arm64
bullets.detail: Dedicated SkiaSharp and HarfBuzzSharp native packages support Linux environments built on Android's Bionic libc.
Native packages now include the official tizen-x64 and tizen-arm64 runtime identifiers.
Versioned library TFMs target Apple 26.0 so consumers are not forced onto a specific later Xcode 26 workload.

v4.147.0-preview.1.1.summary: Introduces Skia m147, SKPathBuilder, variable and color fonts, explicit surface sampling, Linux Bionic assets, and 64-bit Tizen support. Tizen 32-bit assets are removed, parameterless SKFont uses an empty typeface, missing Android font families fall back to the default, and SKStream.Move(long) rejects out-of-range offsets.

v4.147.0-preview.2.1.summary: Adds animated WebP encoding and SKStream.GetData(), fixes the SKPath finalizer crash, and broadens Apple workload compatibility.

v4.147.0-preview.3.1.summary: Raises WebAssembly native assets to .NET 8, adds HBColor and missing graphics wrappers, and refreshes bundled native dependencies.

harfbuzz_summary: HarfBuzzSharp 8.3.1.6 adds variable-font shaping controls, color font palette APIs, and HBColor conversions, plus Linux Bionic and 64-bit Tizen assets.
